issues.description: Method name mismatch for the Stock-clearing operation: the problem statement UML and the solution implementation declare a method named emptyStock(), but the template implementation provides a method named clearInventory(). This naming inconsistency (emptyStock vs clearInventory) can confuse students following the specification and may cause tests or grader code that expect emptyStock() to fail or require students to spend time reconciling the difference.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Rename the template's clearInventory() to emptyStock() (void emptyStock()) so its signature matches the UML and solution, or add a new emptyStock() method in the template that delegates to clearInventory(). Update any comments or documentation references accordingly so students and tests refer to the same identifier.
